skills: Hold with 30+ Solar Prominence: up to 4 hits for massive Ether DMG, each costing some. Switching out during the 3rd lets him finish the 4th off-field.
Spinning Ether slash; with 30+ Solar Prominence, hold to go into the 3rd Celestial Light hit.
Ether combo; same Celestial Light follow-up.
Parries an incoming attack for massive Daze.
Ether thrust; same Celestial Light follow-up.
Charge and combo for massive Ether DMG. Getting hit during the charge is a Perfect Block: no DMG and the move's Interrupt Level rises to a heavy Defensive Assist's. Same Celestial Light follow-up.
His Ultimate or Sun's Halo calls in Phaethon for an Ether assist attack (once per 2.5s; always on Ultimate).
Joint attack with Phaethon for massive Ether DMG; same Celestial Light follow-up.

He picks one of four branches, each with massive Ether DMG and a Celestial Light follow-up: Total Annihilation (charged slash), Triumphant Return (energy burst), Unbound Swordstorm (combo) and Eternal Imprisonment (gather and finisher). Effects are under Core Passive.

core.name: Radiant Chariot
core.text:
Enters battle with 30 Solar Prominence (once per 180s in Investigation Zones); his hits add more, plus 0.5 per second (max 60).
Upper (Total Annihilation): +30 Solar Prominence and Mirage for 21s: Ultimate +40% CRIT DMG on Stunned enemies, and holding on the 4th Celestial Light hit loops back to the 3rd.
Lower (Triumphant Return): Sunflare for 200s: +15% Energy Generation, +{0}% DMG, and EX Perfect Blocks give 10 Solar Prominence.
Left (Unbound Swordstorm): heavy hits on Contaminated enemies add {1}% ATK as DMG.
Right (Eternal Imprisonment): heavy hits on Stunned enemies Totalize for {2}% ATK as extra DMG; extends current Stuns by 3s, and the finisher ends the Stun.

ability.name: Glorious Legion
ability.text: Raises his CRIT DMG, and his Chain Attacks give Decibels. (The wiki doesn't list the exact numbers yet.)

mindscapes: Enters battle with 1,000 Decibels (once per 180s in Investigation Zones). +8% CRIT Rate.
Triumphant Return gives 1,500 Decibels (once per 180s). Decibel cap +1,000.
A Sun's Halo Perfect Block gives a Shield of 8% Max HP for 10s; +10% Daze while shielded.
